contracts.review: The body is `(year & 3) == 0`; the contract states exactly that result.

True: the body returns the serial-comma format for more than two items and the plain format otherwise. Unknown: an override in an unsealed class, so a postcondition would be a contract for every override and is not verified.

True: two appends DualPostfix ("_Dual"), 3 to 10 append PluralPostfix, and every other count returns the key unchanged. Unknown: an override in an unsealed class, so a postcondition would be a contract for every override and is not verified.

True: 12 ends in 2 but is excluded explicitly (`number != 12`), so the key is returned unchanged. Unknown: an override in an unsealed class, so a postcondition would be a contract for every override and is not verified.

True: only counts 2 to 4 take the paucal suffix; every other count returns the key unchanged. Unknown: an override in an unsealed class, so a postcondition would be a contract for every override and is not verified.
Deliberately false: for number == 2 the body appends "_Dual". Unknown: an override in an unsealed class, so a postcondition would be a contract for every override and is not verified.

True: only a last digit of 2 to 4 takes the paucal suffix; a last digit of 7 returns the key unchanged. Unknown: an override in an unsealed class, so a postcondition would be a contract for every override and is not verified.

Deliberately false: 4 takes TrialQuadralPostfix ("_TrialQuadral"), not "_Dual". Unknown: an override in an unsealed class, so a postcondition would be a contract for every override and is not verified.
True: 21 has tens digit 2 and unit digit 1, so the body returns Singular. Proven since enum values lower as their underlying integer.
True: the body is `((year * 7) + 1) % 19 < 7`. Unknown (ResourceLimit): NodaTime compiles with checked arithmetic, and the checked 32-bit multiply with the remainder exhausts the query budget.

Deliberately false: civil month 7 in a non-leap year is scriptural month 1 (Nisan). Unknown (CounterexampleNotReplayable): the witness runs through HebrewScripturalCalculator.IsLeapYear, whose declaring type has a static initializer the replay cannot certify.
True: a false result means the current character differed and the cursor did not move. Unknown (UnsupportedBody): the contract reads `Current`, a property of the TextCursor base class.

True: an even candidate returns `candidate == 2` before the loop. Unknown (CounterexampleNotReplayable): the candidate witness runs through the loop and Math.Sqrt(double), which the replay does not model.
True on normal return, but the body loops and calls Math.Abs, whose fault path is not modeled.
Recursive: a postcondition gets no induction over its own recursive calls. Shares the OSS0015 companion.
